name: Hartwell Ironweave Insulated Cargo Pant
description: Cold-weather cargo trousers with a quilted thermal lining throughout the legs and seat. The outer shell is a dark, tightly woven synthetic with mild wind resistance. Built for outdoor construction and cold-deck warehouse environments. Bulky through the thigh but surprisingly mobile. Most pairs are navy blue or black.
functionality: Quilted thermal insulation, wind-resistant shell, multiple cargo pockets
what_it_says: You work outside or in unheated spaces, and you've learned to layer properly.
story_hooks: The quilted lining can be partially removed through a seam — some workers carry flat items between the shell and liner rather than in visible pockets.
Hartwell Ironweave is recognizable enough that wearing it signals you're from a cold-work environment, which tells people something about where you spend your days.
related_entities: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Bastion Subdermal Armor Mesh

physical_description.visual_profile: Sturdy, utilitarian silhouette with pronounced thigh volume tapering to a straight leg. The quilted thermal interior creates subtle ridge patterns visible across the legs and seat. Projects working-class durability and cold-weather functionality.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with intentional bulk for layering and movement; straight leg with reinforced ankles. Sits at natural waist with articulated knee panels for bending and climbing.
physical_description.primary_material: Tightly woven synthetic composite (ballistic-grade poly blend) with quilted thermal poly-fill lining throughout interior
physical_description.texture: Outer shell is smooth but slightly textured with wind-resistant weave; quilted lining creates visible geometric ridge patterns under fabric. Seams are double-stitched and raised.
physical_description.color_scheme: Navy blue or charcoal black outer shell; quilted lining visible at waistband and cuffs in gray or silver-toned thermal fabric
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty brass YKK zipper fly; reinforced belt loops; optional friction-fit thermal cuff at ankles
distinctive_features: Six cargo pockets (two thigh, two side-hip, two rear) with mesh drain holes
Quilted thermal ridge pattern visible at seams and edges
Reinforced double-stitched inseams rated for warehouse equipment snags
Hartwell Workline label embossed on back waistband
Pre-worn abrasion marks at cuff and inside thighs from industrial use
Concealed thermal hand-warmer pockets at hip seams
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional — solid working-class gear with no luxury finishing, honest manufacturing
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by outdoor construction crews, cold-deck logistics workers, Behemoth maintenance teams, and ungoverned zone scrappers. Signals practical survival mindset and industrial labor.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in with authentic wear: faded stress points at thigh, minor stains, loose stitching at cuffs, but mechanically sound. Thermal lining still intact and functional.
